actions.action: Replace chat updates with one pinned checkout record
actions.mechanism: A shared record separates the last confirmed holder from pending transfers, preventing newer conversation from obscuring custody.
actions.implementation: Pin an editable sheet accessible to both volunteers. Add timestamped handoff rows and a summary showing confirmed holder and unresolved transfers.
actions.check: Enter three completed handoffs among unrelated chat messages; both volunteers must identify the same holder using only the pinned record.
actions.risk: Manual summary edits can contradict the handoff rows.

actions.action: Require the receiving volunteer to confirm each handoff
actions.mechanism: A proposed transfer remains unresolved until its recipient acknowledges physical receipt; sending a message alone cannot establish custody.
actions.implementation: Record sender, recipient, and transfer time. Recipient confirms receipt and its time; only then update the confirmed holder. Block overlapping transfers.
actions.check: Propose a transfer without acknowledgment: it must remain unresolved and preserve the last confirmed holder. Acknowledgment must complete it.
actions.risk: Forgotten confirmation leaves actual custody uncertain despite a clear pending status.

actions.mechanism: Explicit uncertainty prevents stale records from presenting a disputed holder as fact, while preserving unresolved handoff history.
actions.implementation: Before room use, either volunteer can flag a mismatch. Both check possession; record their timestamped responses and resolve custody without deleting prior entries.
actions.check: Simulate a recorded holder denying possession. The record must show custody unverified until the other volunteer confirms possession; retain the discrepancy.
actions.risk: If neither volunteer finds the key, reconciliation cannot establish a holder.
